The '''Jedi spacecraft''' was a [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] on a stealth approach to [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]], with [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] as her gunner. A shielded vessel, its weapons included two wing cannons and a swiveling belly cannon. Despite the stealth attempt, the vessel was detected by the [[Morgukai]] and attacked by a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]].
